mods.description: Wider timing windows (OD x0.5), slower notes, a kinder HP bar.
mods.name: Easy

mods.description: You can't fail, whatever the HP bar says.
mods.name: No Fail

mods.description: 0.75x speed, same pitch.
mods.name: Half Time

mods.description: 0.75x speed, lower pitch.
mods.name: Daycore

mods.description: Every other don/kat is gone. For learning hard maps.
mods.name: Half Notes

mods.description: Big notes become normal ones.
mods.name: No Finishers

mods.description: Tighter windows (OD x1.4), much faster notes, a stricter HP bar.
mods.name: Hard Rock

mods.description: The first miss fails the play.
mods.name: Sudden Death

mods.description: Anything but a GREAT fails the play.
mods.name: Perfect

mods.description: 1.5x speed, same pitch.
mods.name: Double Time

mods.description: 1.5x speed, higher pitch.
mods.name: Nightcore

mods.description: Notes fade out long before they reach the drum.
mods.name: Hidden

mods.description: Only a circle around the drum is lit; it shrinks at 100 and 200 combo.
mods.name: Flashlight

mods.description: OD +2.
mods.name: Precise

mods.description: An OK counts as a miss (but doesn't fail you).
mods.name: Great or Nothing

mods.description: Colours don't matter: any key hits any note.
mods.name: Relax

mods.description: Watch the map play itself.
mods.name: Autoplay

mods.description: Dons become kats and kats become dons.
mods.name: Swap

mods.description: Every note gets a random colour.
mods.name: Random

mods.description: All notes scroll at one speed: no SV changes.
mods.name: Constant Speed

mods.description: The same hand can't hit twice in a row.
mods.name: Alternate

mods.description: The song speeds up from 1.0x to 1.5x of your speed.
mods.name: Wind Up

mods.description: The song slows down from 1.0x to 0.75x of your speed.
mods.name: Wind Down

mods.description: Every don and kat is a big note.
mods.name: All Big

mods.description: Notes start slow and rush in near the drum.
mods.name: Accel

mods.description: Notes fly in fast and brake near the drum.
mods.name: Brake

mods.description: Note speed swells and falls along the song.
mods.name: Wave

mods.description: Notes jump forward on every beat.
mods.name: Pulse

mods.description: Notes freeze for half a beat, then catch up.
mods.name: Stutter

mods.description: Every note gets its own speed (+-30%): they overtake each other.
mods.name: SV Chaos

mods.description: Notes speed up steadily over the map, from 0.8x to 1.6x.
mods.name: Crescendo

mods.description: Notes freeze two beats before every kiai, then slam in 1.4x faster.
mods.name: Drop

mods.description: Every beat of a bar shifts up a gear (+15%); the next bar starts over.
mods.name: Gearbox

mods.description: Every 4 bars a random speed (0.5x-2x); a marker shows where it changes.
mods.name: Roulette

mods.description: The map's speed changes are turned upside down: 2x becomes 0.5x.
mods.name: Anti-SV

mods.description: The map's speed changes are exaggerated: 1.5x becomes 2.25x.
mods.name: Hyper SV

mods.description: Notes are evenly spaced: bursts fly in fast, slow parts crawl. Play by ear.
mods.name: Even

mods.description: Dons are 20% faster and kats 15% slower: colours overtake each other.
mods.name: Split

mods.description: Notes on the beat are faster, notes between beats slower.
mods.name: Swing

mods.description: Every other note is faster: pairs swap places on the way in.
mods.name: Leapfrog

mods.description: Every miss makes notes 15% faster for 4 seconds; misses stack.
mods.name: Panic

mods.description: Every miss slows notes down for a few seconds.
mods.name: Mercy

mods.description: The lane freezes now and then, then skips ahead. Like a bad stream.
mods.name: Lag Spike

mods.description: On every bar the notes slide backwards for a moment.
mods.name: Moonwalk

mods.description: Speed by rhythm: 1/3s slower, 1/6s faster, 1/8s a bit faster than the rest.
mods.name: Snap Speed

mods.description: Notes only show up close to the drum.
mods.name: Sudden

mods.description: Approaching notes vanish on the second half of every beat.
mods.name: Blink

mods.description: Kiai time turns the lights off: only the drum stays lit.
mods.name: Blackout

mods.description: Flashlight whose circle breathes with the beat.
mods.name: Spotlight

mods.description: Dons and kats look the same. Play by ear and memory.
mods.name: Colorless

mods.description: Notes are only shown for the first 15 seconds.
mods.name: Memory

mods.description: See-through fake notes fly in between the real ones and vanish before the drum.
mods.name: Decoy

mods.description: Everything flashy at once; notes pulse to their own rhythm, 1/4s four times a beat.
mods.name: Party

mods.description: It's me.
mods.name: Overtime

mods.description: Far off, triplets are spaced like 1/4s; their real spacing shows near the drum.
mods.name: Liar

mods.description: The lane is dark: a beam sweeps it every beat and lights notes up as it passes.
mods.name: Radar

mods.description: Notes are grey; the next bar shows in colour under the lane, a cursor running along it.
mods.name: Echo

mods.description: The lane zigzags across the screen.
mods.name: Zigzag

mods.description: Notes come in along the top, make a U-turn and come back to the drum.
mods.name: U-Turn

mods.description: The lane coils into a spiral; notes wind their way in.
mods.name: Spiral

mods.description: The lane has a loop-the-loop in the middle.
mods.name: Loop

mods.description: Notes fall from the top and turn into the lane at a corner.
mods.name: Elbow

mods.description: Every few bars the lane bends into another rails shape (C: how often, which order).
mods.name: Shapeshift

mods.description: Streams slither along the lane, triplets the other way; 1/1 notes fly straight.
mods.name: Snake

mods.description: The drum sits in the middle: kats come from the left, dons from the right.
mods.name: Crossfire

mods.description: The lane is flipped: notes come from the left.
mods.name: Mirror

mods.description: The lane rocks from side to side with the beat.
mods.name: Tilt

mods.description: The lane moves to the middle and turns full circle every 24 seconds.
mods.name: Spin

mods.description: The lane stands up: notes fall down onto the drum.
mods.name: Mania

mods.description: Every kiai starts with a full spin of the lane.
mods.name: Barrel Roll

mods.description: Every 8 bars the lane flips over to the other side.
mods.name: Flip Flop

mods.description: The lane breaks into pieces that slide apart and back; further where streams are.
mods.name: Shatter

mods.description: Every miss cracks the lane and knocks a piece out of line; 50 hits mend it.
mods.name: Cracked

mods.description: Hits knock pieces out of the lane, harder as the combo grows; a miss puts them back.
mods.name: Crumble

mods.description: Notes dive into one portal and come out of another; they move every 8 bars.
mods.name: Portal

mods.description: Eight playfields circle about, each with its own look and mods (C sets them up).
mods.name: Multiverse
